metadata.description: Voynich Manuscript (Yale Beinecke MS 408) as one file: every page of the ZL3b transcription in book order, with its text, labels, drawing type and notes, and its Yale page image(s).

how_to_read.unit: paragraph = body text; label = word(s) next to a drawing; circle = text written round a ring; radius = text along a spoke
how_to_read.position: ZL3b position note for the line, e.g. clock position '09:00', compass 'N', or rosette 'circle:locus' like '2:11'
how_to_read.drawing_breaks: places where a drawing cuts through a line of text (<-> in ZL3b)
how_to_read.image_match: how the page was tied to its photo: 'Yale label', 'checked' (looked at), or 'page order' (foldout panels in the same order)

transcriber_notes: Three concentric rings of text, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
to inner). In the centre is a Taurus feeding from a manger. Below
the bull is the word ``May'' in the Roman alphabet. Between the
inner ring of text and the middle ring are five
human figures, each in a barrel, holding a star, and labelled with a word
of Voynich text. One is naked, four are clothed. Between the middle ring
and the outer ring are 10 human figures, each in a barrel, holding a star,
and labeled with a word of Voynich text. Two are naked, eight are clothed.
Newbold calls this folio 79 and he reads the date of the comet 1273.
The photograph in Newbold is cropped, so part of ring C1 isn't visible.
